content.value: An FIR bandpass filter is to be designed to meet the following frequency response (10) specifications:

content.value_html:
Passband0.18-0.33 (normalized)
Transition width0.04 (normalized)
Stopband deviation0.001
Passband deviation0.05

content.value: (i) Sketch the tolerance scheme for the filter.
(ii) Express the filter band edge frequencies in the standard unit of kilohertz, assuming a sampling frequency of 1 OkHz and the stopband and passband deviations in decibels.
Define phase delay and group delay. Describe the necessary conditions of a filter to have linear (10) phase response characteristics.
